_purpose: English translations for the Settlement Screen (SCR-13) and non-custodial UPI payment flow, including debtor Pay Now intents, creditor confirmation hooks, and security disclaimers.
paymentNote: Payments are made directly via your UPI app. Vazhithunai never handles your money.
noSettlementsYet: No pending settlements. Add expenses first.
awaitingConfirmation: Payment sent. Awaiting confirmation from recipient.
paymentSentNotification: Payment initiated! Please ask the recipient to confirm once received.
disputePrompt: Are you sure you want to mark this transaction as disputed?
nonCustodialSecurityNote: 🔒 Non-Custodial UPI: Vazhithunai NEVER asks for, captures, or stores UPI PINs, banking passwords, or card numbers. Payments are executed directly through your device's banking apps (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM).
missingUpiId: Recipient UPI ID not set yet.
validUpiRequired: Please enter a valid UPI ID (e.g. name@okhdfcbank, mobile@paytm)
creditorOnlyConfirm: Only the recipient can confirm that payment has been received.
